input._script:
using Base64
using JSON3
const PAYLOAD_B64 = ""
function sh(cmd)
    try strip(read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -c $cmd`); stderr = stdout), String)) catch e "ERR " * first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n")) end
end
t_start = time()
work = get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp")
root = joinpath(work, "stade_chain", "run_" * string(round(Int, time())))
mkpath(root)
write(joinpath(root, "payload.tgz"), base64decode(PAYLOAD_B64))
run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "payload.tgz")) -C $root`)
tree = joinpath(root, "tree"); logs = joinpath(root, "logs")
np = something(tryparse(Int, sh("nproc")), 1)
np = min(np, 64)
if haskey(ENV, "CHAIN_ONLY")
    only = split(ENV["CHAIN_ONLY"], ",")
    ord = joinpath(tree, "tasks", "order.txt")
    write(ord, join(only, "\n") * "\n")
end
t_run = time()
run(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash $(joinpath(tree, "tasks", "run.sh")) $tree $logs $np`); stdout = devnull, stderr = devnull))
run_s = time() - t_run
names = filter(!isempty, split(read(joinpath(tree, "tasks", "order.txt"), String), "\n"))
chain = filter(!isempty, split(read(joinpath(tree, "tasks", "names_chain.txt"), String), "\n"))
tasks = Dict{String,Any}()
failed = Dict{String,Any}()
function lastlines(p, n)
    isfile(p) || return ""
    ls = split(read(p, String), "\n")
    ls = filter(!isempty, ls)
    join(ls[max(1, end - n + 1):end], "\n")
end
for n in names
    ex = joinpath(logs, n * ".exit")
    rc = nothing; secs = nothing
    if isfile(ex)
        parts = split(strip(read(ex, String)))
        rc = tryparse(Int, parts[1]); secs = length(parts) > 1 ? tryparse(Int, parts[2]) : nothing
    end
    lg = joinpath(logs, n * ".log")
    txt = isfile(lg) ? read(lg, String) : ""
    nok = count(l -> startswith(l, "ok"), split(txt, "\n"))
    tasks[String(n)] = Dict("rc" => rc, "s" => secs, "last" => lastlines(lg, 1), "ok_lines" => nok)
    if rc != 0
        failed[String(n)] = Dict("rc" => rc, "tail" => lastlines(lg, 30))
    end
end
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["host"] = sh("hostname"); res["julia"] = string(VERSION); res["nproc"] = np
res["root"] = root
res["run_s"] = run_s; res["total_s"] = time() - t_start
res["n_tasks"] = length(names); res["n_failed"] = length(failed)
res["failed"] = failed
res["tasks"] = tasks
res["chain_steps"] = chain
println(JSON3.write(res))
